detail_of_failure: Large unusual noise is heard at swing stop.

branches.YES: • The swing motor safety valve is correct. • Go to the next check item.
branches.NO: • Adjust the hydraulic pressure of the swing motor safety valve. • If it does not become correct even after adjustment, replace the safety valve. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.cause: Left suction valve of swing motor
steps.procedure: 1. Release the pressure that remains in the hydraulic tank and piping. For details, see Testing and Adjusting, “Release Remained Pressure in Hydraulic Circuit”. 2. Interchange the right and left suction valves of the swing motor. 3. Is there no change, and does the phenomenon reproduce?

branches.YES: • The left suction valve of the swing motor is correct. • Go to the next check item.
branches.NO: • Examine the left suction valve of the swing motor for sticking, scratches, or other abnormalities when it is removed. • If the left suction valve of the swing motor is stuck or scratched, replace the valve. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.cause: Right suction valve of swing motor
steps.procedure: 1. Release the pressure that remains in the hydraulic tank and piping. For details, see Testing and Adjusting, “Release Remained Pressure in Hydraulic Circuit”. 2. Interchange the right and left suction valves of the swing motor. 3. Is there no change, and does the phenomenon reproduce?

branches.YES: • The right suction valve of swing motor is correct. • Go to the next check item.
branches.NO: • Examine the right suction valve of the swing motor for sticking, scratches, or other abnormalities when it is removed. • If the right suction valve of the swing motor is stuck or scratched, replace the valve. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.procedure: Is the swing machinery clean, with no unusual noise, abnormal heat, or metal powder in the drain oil?

branches.YES: • The swing machinery is correct. • Go to the next check item.
branches.NO: • The swing machinery is defective. • Replace the swing machinery. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.procedure: 1. Stop the engine. 2. Connect all the component parts. 3. Start the engine. 4. Does the machine swing normally?

branches.NO: Return to the first check item.
